title: Personalized Mindfulness Sessions from Utah
includes: Yoga Mats, props and any comfort items needed can/will be provided
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Private Yoga & Mindfulness Experience in the Utah

Experiences that connects you to your inner and outer landscape.

Enjoy a private, personalized experience designed for you or your group with sessions thoughtfully tailored to your energy, experience level + intentions. Blend yoga, breath work, meditation or sound bath in a way that feels both grounding + accessible.

Choose a studio setting or, when available, we can take our practice to the beautiful mountainous backdrop. 

Whether you’re looking to start your day feeling energized, unwind after an adventure, reconnect with your travel companions, or simply create a meaningful moment during your trip, your session will be created around what you need.

No previous yoga experience is necessary. Come as you are, breathe deeply, move your body + leave feeling refreshed, grounded + deeply connected.

This isn’t just a yoga class, it’s a chance to slow down + experience a different side of Utah and our culture.
